note: The library shelf the lessons read from, and which of the stories under data/ka/stories/ belong on it. A dialogue is built exactly as every other story is — a .txt and its .en.txt through the story builder — so this file says only the one thing a story file cannot: which shelf it is filed on, and what that shelf is called. `npm run db:dialogues` loads it, and leaves alone anything already in the database.

category.name: Dialogues
category.note: Short conversations, each one taught by a lesson. Read them here to look a word up, hear a line again, or rate what you know.
